card.name: The ugh in Child-Pugh
card.fires_on: Mainly the 'ugh' that completes 'Child-Pugh' in cirrhosis class labels such as 'Child-Pugh A' or 'B or C'. It also fires weakly on a noun after a modifier, such as 'scores' after 'very high'.

modes.label: Child-Pugh grading
modes.description: The final piece of 'Child-Pugh' in brackets after a cirrhosis description in hepatitis C dosing tables.

modes.label: Stray noun after modifier
modes.description: A noun right after a descriptive word in general web text, outside medical labels.
